narrative: Material PL1__MC7BAB87 exhibits regular demand patterns with moderate variability (CV=0.339) across 227 working days. Lead times are highly unstable (CV=1.091), ranging from near-zero to 3.57 days, which is the primary driver of safety stock requirements. A stochastic (r,Q) policy is recommended: set safety stock to 909 units (up from the current SAP value of 0) to achieve the 95% service level target, and order 1,798 units per replenishment cycle — capped from the unconstrained EOQ of 1,987 due to the 2,707.8-unit storage limit. The safety lead time in SAP can be marginally reduced from 1.8 to 1.68 days.
warnings: Optimized policy increases total annual cost by $1792.69 (22.0%) due to safety stock requirements.
Storage capacity constraint is binding: EOQ capped from 1987 to 1798 units. Any increase in safety stock would require capacity expansion.

research_insights.selected_model: Stochastic EOQ with Safety Stock (r,Q) continuous-review
research_insights.selection_rationale: Regular demand regime (CV=0.339, 100% non-zero days) with unstable lead times (CV=1.091) is the canonical fit for a continuous-review reorder-point model. Safety stock is computed from the joint demand-lead-time variance formula at z=1.645 (95th percentile). EOQ minimises total ordering plus holding cost subject to the storage capacity constraint.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity is fully consumed at the recommended policy (909 SS + 1798 OQ = 2707 units vs. 2707.8 limit). A service level increase or demand spike would breach capacity. Recommend reviewing warehouse allocation for this material.
research_insights.escalation_flag: No MOQ-capacity infeasibility (MOQ 1068 < remaining storage 1798). However, zero headroom above capacity — flag for facility planning review.
